name: 71909 · Hot Springs, AR
findings: ZIP 71909 (Hot Springs) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (49% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71909 (Hot Springs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
